name: Engine M8: showcase fixtures, authoring guide, JSON Schema export
description: Makes the engine usable by people and models: a JSON Schema export for tool calling, an authoring guide with recipes, and three showcase docs (product turntable, title card, robot dance) that run through the lab page and the e2e spec.

manualGates: MG-1: owner watches the three showcase docs on http://localhost:5173/motion-lab.html and judges whether they look good enough to show.

stories.title: Export the MotionDoc JSON Schema for tool calling
stories.description: As a future agent tool author, I want the MotionDoc as JSON Schema so that a model can be given the exact shape to write.
steps: Read engine/src/schema/doc.ts and how zod-to-json-schema is used elsewhere in the repo (grep server/ for zodToJsonSchema) without importing from server/.

Create engine/src/schema/jsonSchema.ts exporting motionDocJsonSchema() using zod-to-json-schema on the input schema (target 'jsonSchema7', $refStrategy 'none' or 'root' so group recursion works) and add a description string to the top level that names the five layer types.
acceptance: motionDocJsonSchema() returns an object with type 'object' and required containing version, width, height, duration and layers
The schema's layer definition lists the five type values image, text, shape, group and three
JSON.stringify of the schema is under 200 KB

stories.title: Authoring guide with recipes
stories.description: As a person or model writing a MotionDoc, I want a short guide with copyable recipes so that good-looking docs are easy and wrong ones are rare.
steps: Read engine/docs/01-schema.md, 02-timeline.md (presets, target paths), 05-effects.md and the fixtures.

Write engine/docs/authoring.md: units and coordinates (seconds, pixels, degrees, metres in 3D, anchor), layer order, the 8 cross-field rules in plain words, the preset list with one line each, the target path table, and six recipes as JSON snippets (title in and out, product turntable over a plate, glow pulse via an effect:<id> tween on text, camera dolly, glTF clip with a spin loop, bloom swell via an effect:<id> tween on a three layer).
Validate every complete doc snippet in the guide by pasting it into a scratch test that runs parseMotionDoc, then delete the scratch test (keep the guide only).
acceptance: engine/docs/authoring.md contains six recipes and each complete doc in it parses with parseMotionDoc (recorded in notes)
Every preset name and every effect type in the guide exists in engine/src/schema/enums.ts

stories.title: Three showcase docs
stories.description: As a project owner, I want three polished docs that show what Motion can do so that I can judge it and show it.
steps: Read engine/docs/authoring.md (US-002) and the existing fixtures.

Create engine/fixtures/showcase-product-turntable.json (8 s, 1920x1080): blurred backdrop plate, the can glTF turning slowly in golden light with shadow, bloom swelling at 3 s, a headline with slideInUp and a glow that fades, a price shape-and-text card with popIn.

Create engine/fixtures/showcase-title-card.json (5 s): layered shapes and text using enter, loop and exit presets and three effects (brightnessContrast on the stage, chromaticAberration tweened to 0, dropShadow).
Create engine/fixtures/showcase-robot-dance.json (8 s, 1080x1080): the robot playing 'Dance' with a camera move (position and lookAt tweens), dof focused on the robot, vignette, and a title text.
Run the fixtures test and `npm run engine:e2e` (the spec picks the new files up automatically) and view each on http://localhost:5173/motion-lab.html; save screenshots to debug/engine/.
acceptance: All three showcase files parse with parseMotionDoc and validateTargets returns no errors
`npm run engine:e2e` passes including the three showcase docs
notes describes what each showcase looks like at 25 %, 50 % and 75 % of its duration
